fields.Name: T129 - Actions Overview KPI Cards and Card Navigation
fields.Description: Exercises the bespoke ActionsOverview dashboard — computed KPI cards + clickable-card navigation (onTotalActionsClick/onExecutionsClick/onCategoriesClick) — not a generic entity grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) and switch to the 'Actions' application. It lands on the 'Actions Overview' page (default nav item). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Verify the overview renders its KPI metric cards (Total Actions with an Active/Pending/Disabled breakdown, Total Executions, Categories, AI Generated). Then click the 'Total Actions' metric card and confirm the app navigates to another Actions view (e.g. the Explorer/list of actions). Seeing the metric cards render and the card click drive navigation is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Actions Overview page renders a row of KPI metric cards showing numeric counts (Total Actions, Executions, Categories, AI Generated)
At least one metric card shows a breakdown sub-line (e.g. Active / Pending / Disabled counts) rather than a bare number
Clicking a clickable metric card navigates to a different Actions view (URL or main content changes)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
